scripts.remote:run:markets: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl start worker-market-sync && sudo journalctl -u worker-market-sync --no-pager -f'
scripts.remote:run:funding: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl start worker-funding-rates && sudo journalctl -u worker-funding-rates --no-pager -f'
scripts.remote:validate:funding: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'docker compose -f /opt/arbinet/docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm -T worker-validate-funding'
scripts.remote:validate:quotes: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'docker compose -f /opt/arbinet/docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm -T worker-validate-quotes'
scripts.remote:analyze:funding-download-tasks: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'docker compose -f /opt/arbinet/docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm -T -e MODE=analyze worker-funding-download-tasks'
scripts.remote:create:funding-download-tasks: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'docker compose -f /opt/arbinet/docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm -T -e MODE=create worker-funding-download-tasks'
scripts.remote:timer:add:markets: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl enable worker-market-sync.timer && sudo systemctl start worker-market-sync.timer && systemctl status worker-market-sync.timer'
scripts.remote:timer:add:funding: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl enable worker-funding-rates.timer && sudo systemctl start worker-funding-rates.timer && systemctl status worker-funding-rates.timer'
scripts.remote:timer:remove:markets: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl disable worker-market-sync.timer && sudo systemctl stop worker-market-sync.timer'
scripts.remote:timer:remove:funding: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl disable worker-funding-rates.timer && sudo systemctl stop worker-funding-rates.timer'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.infra:apply: cd terraform && terraform apply && npm run infra:inventory
scripts.deploy:migrate: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl start worker-migrate && sudo journalctl -u worker-migrate --no-pager --since "5 minutes ago" && test "$(sudo systemctl show worker-migrate -p Result --value)" = "success"'
scripts.remote:ssh: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip)
scripts.remote:status: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'docker ps && systemctl list-timers worker-*'
scripts.remote:logs:markets: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo journalctl -u worker-market-sync -f'
scripts.remote:logs:funding: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo journalctl -u worker-funding-rates -f'
scripts.remote:logs:quotes: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo journalctl -u worker-quote-sync-coordinator -f'
scripts.remote:quote-sync: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl start worker-quote-sync-coordinator && sudo journalctl -u worker-quote-sync-coordinator --no-pager -f'
scripts.remote:funding-backfill: ssh -i ~/.ssh/nicolas nicolas@$(cd terraform && terraform output -raw server_ip) 'sudo systemctl start worker-funding-rates-backfill && sudo journalctl -u worker-funding-rates-backfill --no-pager -f'
